_readme: The one list of markets. You own it: the render module, slots.html, header.html, render-all.sh and widthtest.sh all read it, and nothing else hard-codes a locale. The two entries are EXAMPLES to replace: one left to right, one right to left, so both paths stay testable. Add a market here, add its copy in page/copy.js and its data in the world (SampleWorld.kt). See references/android-compose.md, 'Adding a market'. upload: true puts a market on the allow list of the upload_art lane; set it only after the owner approved that market's renders.
_surfaces: What your app has. Phone screens are always on. Add only what you ship: widgets, notification (a live notification, Live Update or live card), wear (a Wear OS app or tile), tablet. Leave the list as ["screens"] and every optional render, slot part and staging step is skipped. The sample lists them all so every path stays testable.
